auth.alert: 🔑 {{text}} After signing in, restart the team with “Resume” in the top bar.

toast.noIdleAgent: No idle agent in this project
toast.agentDisabled: {{name}} is turned off: turn the agent on or assign the task to someone else

caps.terminalSandbox: running commands in its sandbox (Codex always can)
caps.always: saving to the project's files, and the project memory and skills when they're on

runs.agentDisabled: The agent was turned off before the run started

log.runStoppedToTodo: ■ Run stopped (task moved back to “To do”)
log.reviewUnclear: {{key}}: the review gave no clear verdict (approved: true / false); waiting for the user
log.reviewStale: Review of {{key}} dropped: a newer run or changed task details — reviewing the current state
log.workStarted: Work started in this project for this session
log.filesNotReadyAtStart: ⚠ Not ready yet when the work started (still being read in): {{names}}

chat.leadDirectTask: 🎯 The user gave {{agent}} a direct task: {{key}} “{{title}}”
chat.leadQueued: 🎯 The user queued an instruction for {{agent}} on {{key}}: “{{text}}”
chat.noteWithFiles_one: Note and {{count}} file linked to the task; the agent working on it can read it in its next run.
chat.noteWithFiles_other: Note and {{count}} files linked to the task; the agent working on it can read them in its next run.
chat.noteAdded: Note added to the task context; the agent will take it into account in its next run.
chat.noLead: This project has no lead. Choose a lead in the project settings or add a team to the project.
chat.decisionsAdded_one: 🧭 {{count}} decision proposal added to the Decisions tab.
chat.decisionsAdded_other: 🧭 {{count}} decision proposals added to the Decisions tab.
chat.interruptedHeld: ⏸ This task was interrupted when Agentbits closed. It may have done part of its work, so it is not restarted automatically — start it again when you are ready.
chat.reviewUnclear: ⚠ {{lead}}’s review did not contain a clear verdict. The task stays in review: approve it (move it to Done) or send it back yourself.
chat.revisionLimit: ⏸ Sent back {{count}} times. The task waits for you now instead of running again — check the review notes and start it when ready.
chat.leadNotesUnknown: ⚠️ No such task in this project, note not delivered: {{keys}}
chat.handedToTwin: ↔ {{key}} handed from {{from}} (busy) to {{to}}, same role and skills
chat.fileConflict: ⚠️ {{path}} is also being changed by {{other}} ({{key}}) right now — check each other's changes.
chat.taskFailedHeld:
⚠️ {{agent}} couldn't finish this task: {{text}}
The task waits in To do and won't start again on its own: the attempt may have changed files or other systems before it stopped. Check what it left behind, then press “Try again” (the agent is told about the earlier attempt and checks first), or edit or delete the task.
chat.reviewNeedsYou:
⚠️ {{reason}}
The worker's report is kept and the task stays in review. You can retry just the review (the worker doesn't run again), or decide yourself: move it to Done, or back to To do with a note.
chat.workNotStarted: The tasks are ready but won't start yet: work in this project hasn't been started in this session. Press “Start work in this project” at the top.
chat.reviewNoReport:
⚠️ {{reason}}
The task stays in review. Reviewing again won't help without a report: “Run the worker again” does the work from the start (nothing the earlier attempt did is undone), or decide yourself: move it to Done, or back to To do with a note.
chat.reviewNoLead:
⚠️ {{reason}}
The task stays in review. Turn on or add a lead (or a member who can review), then press “Retry the review” on the task, or decide yourself: move it to Done, or back to To do with a note.

errors.noFolder: No folder selected for “{{project}}”. CLI agents can touch files, so choose a folder in the project settings.
errors.instructionTooLong: The instruction is too long (max {{max}} characters)
errors.agentMovedOn: {{name}} has moved on to another run meanwhile
errors.staleRun: {{why}}. Check the terminal and send the instruction again.
errors.attachmentMissing: One of the attachments was not found (it may have been deleted)
errors.attachmentOtherProject: An attachment belongs to another project
errors.agentWorking: {{name}} is working right now; send the instruction as a redirect or queue it
errors.agentNotWorking: {{name}} is not working on a task right now; send it as a new task
errors.stillRunning: Some work did not stop in time (a long database / server call or app tool may still be running). Nothing was deleted — wait a moment and try again.
errors.retryReviewNotInReview: {{key}} isn't in review, so there is no review to retry.
errors.retryReviewNoLead: This project has no active lead to review the task. Assign or turn on a lead first, or decide yourself.
errors.cardNotHere: This request belongs to another project.
errors.cardAction: That isn't possible for this request any more.
errors.reviewQueued: A review of this task is already queued; it runs on its turn.

result.queued: Instruction queued; it will be applied when the current step finishes
result.queuedForApproval: The instruction will be applied once the run is approved

report.customEmpty: Describe what the report should cover.

providers.toolRoundLimit: The agent hit the tool call limit ({{max}} rounds) before finishing. Split the task into smaller steps or start it again.
providers.claudeNotFound: Claude Code CLI not found. Install it with `npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` or the official installer.
providers.permissionDenied: Permission denied (permission matrix / outside the workspace): {{tool}} {{target}}
providers.claudeNotLoggedIn: Claude Code found ({{version}}) but not signed in. Run `claude auth login` in a terminal.
providers.codexNotFound: Codex CLI not found. Install it with `npm i -g @openai/codex`.
providers.codexNeedsRead: Codex always reads files in its sandbox; give this agent the "File read" permission or choose another provider
providers.streamIncomplete: {{provider}}: the answer stopped before it was finished (connection dropped). Try again.
providers.tokenLimit: {{provider}}: the answer hit the output length limit and was cut off before it was finished. Split the task into smaller steps or try again.

db.duplicateAgent: An agent with this name already exists: {{name}}
db.instructionCancelledOnRestart: The app restarted; the pending instruction was cancelled

maintenance.notABackup: This file is not a valid Agentbits backup
maintenance.backupDamaged: This backup file is damaged and can't be restored.
maintenance.backupTooNew: This backup comes from a newer Agentbits version (schema {{version}}; this one knows up to {{latest}}). Update Agentbits first.

devServer.title: Could not connect to the development server
devServer.unreachable: Electron could not reach the Vite server ({{url}}).
devServer.step1: Close the terminal and run npm run dev again.
devServer.step2: In a separate PowerShell, check that the server responds with curl.exe -I {{url}}.
devServer.step3: An antivirus or firewall may be blocking Node.js's local connection.
devServer.step4: To try without the development server: npm run build, then npm start.

limits.time: ⏱ Time limit reached ({{minutes}} min): the run was stopped and the task waits for you.
limits.tokens: ⏱ Token limit reached ({{tokens}}): the run was stopped and the task waits for you.
limits.cost: ⏱ Cost limit reached ({{cost}} USD): the run was stopped and the task waits for you.

worktree.notRepo: Each task is set to work in its own git working copy, but the project folder is not the top of a git repository with at least one commit. The task was held so it doesn't work in the shared folder: make a first commit (or turn the setting off) and start it again.
worktree.reused: 🌿 Continuing in the working copy of branch {{branch}}
worktree.failed: The task's git working copy could not be prepared ({{error}}). The task was held so it doesn't work in the shared folder; fix the repository and start it again.
worktree.noChanges: 🌿 No file changes to commit on {{branch}}
worktree.commitFailed: Could not commit the changes in the working copy: {{error}}
worktree.merged: 🔀 “{{title}}”: branch {{branch}} merged into the project folder. · {{key}}
worktree.dirty: ⏸ “{{title}}”: the project folder has uncommitted changes, so {{branch}} was not merged. Commit or stash them, then use “Review changes and merge” in the task. · {{key}}
worktree.conflict: ⚠️ “{{title}}”: merging {{branch}} conflicts with the project ({{files}}). The task went back to its agent to resolve the conflicts in its working copy. · {{key}}
worktree.conflictNote: Merging this task into the project hit conflicts in: {{files}}. The project's latest state was merged into your branch; resolve the conflict markers (<<<<<<< ======= >>>>>>>) in those files so both changes work together, then finish with your report.
worktree.mergeFailed: ⚠️ “{{title}}”: merging {{branch}} failed: {{error}}. Nothing was merged and it won't be retried on its own; fix the cause, then use “Review changes and merge” in the task. · {{key}}
worktree.changedSinceShown: {{key}}: the task's working copy changed after you looked at it, so nothing was merged. Look at the changes again.
worktree.uncommittedKept: the working copy still has changes that could not be committed, so it was kept

race.started: 🏁 Race: {{key}} also went to {{b}} ({{bProvider}}) as {{copy}}; {{a}} ({{aProvider}}) works on the original. The lead keeps the better attempt.
race.noRival: 🏁 Race mode: no free member on another provider or model, so {{key}} runs alone.
race.waiting: 🏁 Waiting for {{key}} to finish; the lead then compares both attempts.
race.unclear: 🏁 {{lead}} could not pick a winner; both attempts wait in review for you.
race.decided: 🏁 {{winner}} ({{wName}}) won; {{loser}} was closed and its changes discarded. {{note}}
race.needsWorktree: 🏁 Race mode skipped for {{key}}: this project has a folder but no separate working copies per task, so two attempts would overwrite each other. Turn on "Each task in its own git working copy" in the project settings.
race.none: 🏁 Neither {{a}} nor {{b}} did the task: {{a}} goes back to its agent, {{b}} was closed and its changes discarded. {{note}}
race.noneNote: Closed: neither attempt did the task; {{key}} goes back to its agent.

held.agentDisabled: Its agent was turned off before the run started
held.revisionLimit: Sent back {{count}} times by the lead
held.commitFailed: The agent's changes could not be committed in its working copy (e.g. a git signing setting). They are kept there; fix git and start the task again.
held.authFailed: The provider login isn't valid — sign in again, then restart it
held.capsChanged: What the agent can use changed while it waited for your approval; start it again to see the current list

errorKinds.timeout: {{provider}} didn't answer in time. Try again later; if it keeps happening, check the connection or the limits in Settings.
errorKinds.network: Couldn't reach {{provider}} (network). Check the internet connection, VPN or proxy, then try again.
errorKinds.overloaded: {{provider}} is busy or limiting requests right now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errorKinds.exit: The {{provider}} program stopped with an error. The agent terminal shows what it printed.

reviewIssue.noLead: Nobody in this project can review it (no active lead or member)
reviewIssue.noReport: There is no worker report to review
reviewIssue.filesNotReady: Some files changed by the work aren't ready yet ({{files}}: still being read in after the change), so the lead didn't judge it. Retry the review in a moment, or decide yourself.
reviewIssue.notMoving: {{lead}} sent it back again, but the last run recorded no change; it wasn't restarted on its own.

changesWhere.worktree: in the task's working copy (branch {{branch}}), not merged into the project
changesWhere.noFolder: in the folder the agent worked in ({{folder}}; this project has no folder of its own)

changesLeft.stopped: ⏹ Stopped. Nothing was undone: what the agent changed so far is {{where}}. Look at it before you start the task again.
changesLeft.limit: ⏹ Stopped by a run limit. Nothing was undone: what the agent changed so far is {{where}}. Look at it before you start the task again.
changesLeft.manualDone: ✔ You marked it done, without the lead's review. Its changes are {{where}}.

say.sentForReview: {{worker}} finished “{{title}}”; it has gone to the lead ({{lead}}) for review. Nothing needed from you. · {{key}}
say.doneNoReview: {{worker}} finished “{{title}}”. Lead review is off, so it's your call: move it to Done or send it back to To do with a note. · {{key}}
say.doneNoLead: {{worker}} finished “{{title}}”. There's no lead to review it, so it's your call: move it to Done or send it back to To do with a note. · {{key}}
say.commitFailed: {{worker}} finished “{{title}}”, but the changes couldn't be committed in the task's copy, so the task stopped. The reason is on the task page; fix it, then press “{{retry}}”. · {{key}}
say.sentBack: {{lead}} sent “{{title}}” back.{{summary}} It runs again when {{worker}} is free; nothing needed from you for now. · {{key}}
say.sentBackWaits: {{lead}} sent “{{title}}” back.{{summary}} It's in To do again and runs when you start it. · {{key}}
say.unverifiable: {{lead}} couldn't verify “{{title}}”.{{summary}} {{worker}} reported it done, but it hasn't been checked. Your call: press “{{retryReview}}”, move it to Done, or send it back to To do with a note. · {{key}}
say.notMoving: “{{title}}” isn't moving: the run after the send-back recorded no change and {{lead}} sent it back again. It won't restart on its own. Your call: check the lead's note on the task page, then press “{{retryReview}}” or “{{rerunWorker}}”, move it to Done, or send it back to To do with a note. · {{key}}
say.limit: “{{title}}” was sent back {{count}} times; it won't restart on its own. Your call: check the lead's note on the task page, then press “{{retry}}”, edit the task, or move it to Done. · {{key}}
say.changesInFolder: The changes are in the project folder.
say.runApproval: “{{title}}” is waiting for your approval to start. {{worker}} will be able to use: {{caps}}. Approving doesn't widen these permissions; it only lets the run start. If you reject it, the work doesn't start and the task is held. · {{key}}
say.failed: “{{title}}” stopped with an error: {{reason}} It won't restart on its own. “{{retry}}” runs the work again from the start; nothing the earlier attempt did is undone. · {{key}}
say.limitStopped: “{{title}}” stopped at a limit: {{reason}} It won't restart on its own. “{{retry}}” runs the work again; nothing the earlier attempt did is undone. · {{key}}
say.isolation: “{{title}}” couldn't start: {{reason}} It won't start on its own; fix it, then press “{{retry}}”. · {{key}}
say.auth: “{{title}}” stopped because of the provider sign-in: {{reason}} Fix the sign-in first, then press “{{retry}}”; nothing the earlier attempt did is undone. · {{key}}
